faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (adswizz vergibt je Abruf eine listeningSessionID, AIS leitet ueber hash_redirect um, Last-Modified liegt nur 62 s vor dem Abruf, Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst podtrac.com) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: Manny Ax answers personal questions about music books, idols and favorite composers.
kurzfassung: Podcast host Manny Ax steps into the interviewee seat to answer rapid-fire questions from producer Lauren Purcell-Joiner. He shares personal anecdotes about meeting Arthur Rubinstein, his favorite music memoirs, and why he would love to grab coffee with Mozart. The episode offers a rare, lighthearted glimpse into the personal tastes and musical heroes of the renowned pianist.
stichpunkte: Manny Ax shares his go-to drinks after long days and concerts
Recommended music memoirs include books by Gary Grafman, John Adams, and Charles Rosen
Meeting Arthur Rubinstein as a teenager left a lasting impression
A worn-out LP of a Brahms concerto proved his deep admiration for Rubinstein
Mozart and Berlioz top the list of composers he would invite for coffee
Childhood pianistic heroes included Horowitz and Rubinstein
Cellist Yo-Yo Ma is highlighted as a major life-long inspiration and close friend
Listeners are invited to submit more questions for future episodes

clips.text: The pianist highlights a brilliant historical volume dedicated to piano repertoire.
A childhood idol barely noticed a young pianist's audition before handing over a freshly recorded album.

clips.hook: Why Mozart would make the best coffee date
clips.text: The historical composer is imagined as an irreverent guest full of crude jokes and harsh gossip about everyone.

beschreibung:
Producer Lauren Purcell-Joiner puts Classical Music Happy Hour host Manny Ax in the hot seat with the tough questions: What’s his favorite drink? The best book about music he’s ever read? And which composer would he most like to grab coffee with?
